# Indian Space Hub Store — Official ISRO Inspired Merchandise Platform

> **Indian Space Hub Tagline**: The New Era of Indian Space  
> **Merchandise Tagline**: Wear India's Space Story.
> **App Loyalty Reward**: Earn +299 XP Points on Indian Space Hub App with every product drop!

## Overview
Indian Space Hub Store (`shop.indianspacehub.com`) is the official merchandise catalog for ISRO-inspired space merchandise, apparel (oversized t-shirts, sweatshirts, hoodies), telescopes, 1:100 scale model rockets (LVM3, PSLV, Gaganyaan, Chandrayaan-3), and space gear in India.

The store features a community-driven drop pre-registration model: visitors register interest for upcoming drops, select their size, and provide contact info. Once the community interest target is reached, manufacturing and shipping unlock.

## App XP Reward System
- **299 XP Bonus**: With every product drop interest registration or pre-order on `shop.indianspacehub.com`, users earn **299 XP points** directly credited to their official **Indian Space Hub App** account on Google Play.

## Domain & System Architecture
- **Primary Store Domain**: https://shop.indianspacehub.com
- **Main Platform**: https://indianspacehub.com
- **Official Android App**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kapildevpal.indiaspacehub
- **Target Audience**: ISRO fans, space enthusiasts, astronomy lovers, engineers, students, and space dreamers in India & worldwide.
- **Currency**: Indian Rupee (INR / ₹)
- **Official Support Email**: crew@indianspacehub.com

## Core ISRO Merchandise Offerings
- **ISRO Mission Apparel**: Bio-washed 100% combed cotton oversized t-shirts ("Not Lost. Just Orbiting.", "Indian Space Hub Oat T-Shirt"), Chandrayaan-3 black sweatshirts, and Gaganyaan crew hoodies.
- **Scale Model Launch Vehicles**: Authentic 1:100 scale models of ISRO rockets (LVM3 / GSLV Mk III, PSLV-C57, SSLV).
- **Astronomy Optical Equipment**: Refractor telescopes (70mm aperture) for lunar & planetary observation.
- **Space Collectibles**: ISRO mission patches, enamel badges, and desk models.
